prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in seen or grid[r][c] == bg:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    p = (ny, nx)
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and p not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            norm = frozenset((y-r0, x-c0) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append(dict(color=color, cells=cells, box=(r0,r1,c0,c1), norm=norm))
    for obj in objects:
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = obj['box']
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        holes = []
        local_seen = set()
        for r in range(r0, r1+1):
            for c in range(c0, c1+1):
                if (r,c) in local_seen or grid[r][c] != bg:
                    continue
                stack = [(r,c)]; local_seen.add((r,c)); cells = []
                while stack:
                    y,x = stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx = y+dy,x+dx; p=(ny,nx)
                        if r0 <= ny <= r1 and c0 <= nx <= c1 and p not in local_seen and grid[ny][nx] == bg:
                            local_seen.add(p); stack.append(p)
                hr0=min(y for y,x in cells); hc0=min(x for y,x in cells)
                norm=frozenset((y-hr0,x-hc0) for y,x in cells)
                matches=[o for o in objects if o is not obj and o['norm']==norm]
                if not matches:
                    break
                holes.append((cells,matches[0]['color']))
            else:
                continue
            break
        else:
